reuse.why: Linking goes through the existing linkBankAccount helper and the server URL through getServer/joinURL, but the transaction download is a new copy rather than a shared downloader.

duplication.why: downloadFintegraTransactions is a near-verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions (and PluggyAi's), differing only in the server URL and log line.

placement.why: Each piece sits where the tree puts that provider's code: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the server-side additions the request needs; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Follows the established per-provider pattern so it is easy to own, though it adds one more copy of the download/error-mapping block that future changes must update in every provider.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses linkBankAccount, getServer, post and BankSyncError as the other providers do.

disguised_duplication.where: The download function is an openly copied Akahu block, not renamed or reshaped to hide it.
